title: Manyhands JSON v1 pull-request link data
description: The data of a result of item sync of a ticket or a document in a pull-request repository, when the sync published, or found current, the item's branch: where to open the pull request. A ticket gets it when its branch holds a provisional closure no primary holds; a document gets it when it has a link row and the primary does not hold the document. Every other item sync answer carries the synchronization's own data. The link is also recorded for the item: item sync records a ticket's link, and only reads a document's, which document promote records. Ticket show and document show read it from there.
